question:
(a + b – c + d)2 – (a – b + c – d)2 = ?
(CGL 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 4a(b + d - c).

a2 – b2 = (a + b)(a – b)
⇒ (a + b – c + d)2 – (a – b + c – d)2
⇒ ((a + b – c + d) + (a – b + c – d)) ((a + b – c + d) – (a - b + c - d))
⇒ (a + b - c + d + a - b + c - d)(a + b - c + d - a + b - c + d)
⇒ 2a × (2b – 2c + 2d)
⇒ 4a (b + d – c)

question:
\({1.0025+6.25×10^{–6}}\over{0.0025+0.95}\) = ? 
(CHSL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 1.0525.

\({1.0025+6.25×10^{–6}}\over{0.0025+0.95}\)
⇒ \({10025×10^{–4}+625×10^{–8}}\over{25×10^{–4}+95×10^{–2}}\)
10–4 cancel out from the numerator and denominator place
⇒ \({(10025+0.0625)×10^{–4}}\over{(25+9500)×10^{–4}}\)
⇒ \(10025.0625\over9525\) = 1.0525
Alternatively:- (digit sum method)
\((1+2+5)+(6+2+5)\over(2+5)+(9+5)\) 
\(8+13\over7+14\) = \(8+(1+3)\over7+1+4\) = \(12\over12 \)
⇒ \(12\over(1+2)\) = 4
Option B = 1.0525
1 + (5 + 2 + 5) = 1 + 12
⇒ 1 + (1 + 2) = 4 (Satisfied)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 1.0525 है।

\({1.0025+6.25×10^{–6}}\over{0.0025+0.95}\)
⇒ \({10025×10^{–4}+625×10^{–8}}\over{25×10^{–4}+95×10^{–2}}\)
अंश और हर के स्थान से 10–4 को हटा दें
⇒ \({(10025+0.0625)×10^{–4}}\over{(25+9500)×10^{–4}}\)
⇒ \(10025.0625\over9525\) = 1.0525
वैकल्पिक रूप से:- (अंक योग विधि)
\((1+2+5)+(6+2+5)\over(2+5)+(9+5)\) 
\(8+13\over7+14\) = \(8+(1+3)\over7+1+4\) = \(12\over12 \)
⇒ \(12\over(1+2)\) = 4
विकल्प B = 1.0525
1 + (5 + 2 + 5) = 1 + 12
⇒ 1 + (1 + 2) = 4 (संतुष्ट)
